scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler dev --config worker/wrangler.jsonc --var SHARED_PAGES:false
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply exusiai-stat --local --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply exusiai-stat --remote --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.jsonc
